description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Baba Juhara Cassim as a member of the Hambantota M/C
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Hambantota Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a seat vacated by resignation. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for public offices.
